root_cause_criterion.criterion: Immediately after `ucl_chunk_skipc (chunk, p)` advances past a backslash escape introducer, `ucl_lex_json_string()` must prove `p < chunk->end` before executing the next-character dereference `c = *p`.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the original two-byte witness, the vulnerable run reaches the post-skip guard event with `p == chunk->end` and still executes the protected dereference. The fixed original reaches the same guard event but returns before the dereference, while the adjacent one-byte extension `append_escape_byte_backslash` shows the fixed code does execute that dereference when `p < chunk->end` is true.

nodes.description: At the crash site `c = *p;`, the dereference consumes the same cursor pointer observed at the post-skip guard event, making this the AddressSanitizer-reported one-byte read past the end on the original witness.

edges.relation: The cursor pointer produced by the backslash-consuming `ucl_chunk_skipc (chunk, p)` step is carried unchanged into the immediately following `c = *p` dereference.
